instruction: Update all my Spotify playlist titles with the most common song genre in that playlist in this format: "<original_title> | <most_common_genre>". Replace <original_title> and <most_common_genre> with the actual values.
notes: The number of playlists and songs is unknown up front, so the problem uses placeholders: 2 playlists with 3 songs each and 3 placeholder genres; at runtime one playlist object per entry of show_playlist_library and one song object per entry of show_playlist is used. World structure (in-playlist, song-genre, most-common-genre, new-title, song-count) is encoded as static facts in :init; agent knowledge is tracked separately by playlists-listed, songs-known, known-genre/genre-checked. Because quantified conditions are not allowed, 'all genres of a playlist are known' is encoded with a STRIPS counter (genres-known-count vs song-count over count objects n0..n3 and succ), and 'all playlists updated' with the counter updated-count vs playlist-count, which is the quantifier-free equivalent of the goal's title-updated conjunction and serves as the precondition of supervisor-complete-task. update_playlist only changes the title (format '<original_title> | <most_common_genre>'), matching the evaluation that only spotify.Playlist.title may change and no playlist is added or removed. The title object's value is computed at runtime from the playlist's original title and the most frequent genre returned by show_song over its songs. complete_task is called without an answer.

plan: (spotify-update-playlist playlist-1 spotify-token new-title-1 genre-pop n3 n0 n1)
(spotify-update-playlist playlist-2 spotify-token new-title-2 genre-jazz n3 n1 n2)
